content: Inexhaustible emanations of manifold excellence,Engaged in wondrous displays across oceans of buddha-fields,Sole essence of all Victors, treasury of compassion,At the feet of Dbang-phyug Rdo-rje, I pray.Whose nature is a form pervading the expanse of phenomena,Constantly appearing as the basis of knowledge for the aspirations of beings,The actual three vajras, all-pervasive and unchanging,At the feet of Chos-dbyings Rdo-rje, I pray.Universal embodiment of the Victors of the three times, the Karma-pa,Who holds mastery over the accomplishment of infinite enlightened activities,To the lineage of incarnations renowned as Ta'i Si-tu,Who have appeared in succession, I pray.Regent Maitreya and Ḍombī Heruka,The powerful subject cared for by Gzugs-can-snying-po,And Dārika, cared for by Saraha—To these three who have attained the vajra-ground, I pray.Gyim-shang-zhabs, cared for by Padmasambhava,The actual Dgyes-mdzad, cared for by the uncontested Nāro,Dbon-sgom-pa, cared for by the Incomparable Dwags-po—To these three glorious Herukas, I pray.Ras-chen-zhabs, cared for by the Knower of the Three Times,Ye-shes-dbang, cared for by Karma-pakshi,Ri-mgo-ba, cared for by Rang-byung-rdo-rje—To these three who have mastered enlightened activity, I pray.Tai-zhing-che, cared for by Rol-pa'i-rdo-rje,Chos-rgyal-mtshan, cared for by the Tathāgata,Bkra-shis-rnam-rgyal-zhabs, cared for by Don-ldan—To these three who make every connection meaningful, I pray.Bkra-shis-mtshan, cared for by the All-Knowing Rang-byung,Chos-kyi-go-cha, cared for by Mi-bskyod-rdo-rje,Chos-kyi-rgyal, cared for by Dbang-phyug-rdo-rje—To these three who uphold the tradition of the teachings, I pray.Mi-pham-pa, cared for by Chos-dbyings-rdo-rje,Legs-bshad-smra, cared for by Ye-shes-rdo-rje,Chos-kyi-'byung, cared for by Byang-chub-rdo-rje—To these three bodhisattvas, I pray.By the power of this prayer, may I and all beings,Attain the level of the Karmapa, who has reached the vajra-ground of the three collections,And having gained mastery to transform enlightened activity as we desire,May we attain the state of holding the vajra of the three secrets.At the earnest request of the meditator Karma Shes-rab, attendant to the Tenth Gyalwang, that a prayer be composed similar to the supplication for Mkha'-khyab, this was written by Si-tu Chos-kyi-rgyal-mtshan in the Wangchuk Cave of Bsam-gtan-yid-'ong-gling.
